children: ReFuels CEO Philip Fjeld is presenting at Pareto Securities' 33rd annual Energy Conference today, 16 September 2026. Please find the presentation attached.
Baden Gowrie-Smith, MD & CFO, Refuels N.V.

ReFuels is decarbonising Europe's truck fleet through its 40% ownership of CNG Fuels - a fully integrated clean fuel infrastructure platform combining sourcing of renewable and sustainable biomethane (Bio-CNG), Renewable Transport Fuel Certificates (RTFCs), and ownership and operation of the UK's largest clean fuel station network. By the end of 2028, the target is to reach capacity to serve 20,000 heavy goods vehicles per day, with the long-term ambition to become Europe's leading integrated supplier of alternative fuels for commercial fleets. For further information, please visit www.refuels.com
